outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart (mean ± SD) of HMGB1 signal intensity for Nuc/Cyto across genotypes; only bars with error bars are shown, no individual data points are overlaid.
The lower graph is a bar chart of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD) across genotypes; no individual animal/cell data points are overlaid despite N=4 mice being averaged.
Panel C is a western blot image only, with no accompanying quantification plot.
Panel D is a line plot of rotarod time vs. week with error bars; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod time across days 1-3 at three ages) with error bars; line plots are exempt.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G contains only immunofluorescence micrographs (Calbindin, DAPI, Merge), no plot.
Panel H shows two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD across nine mice per group) with only error bars and no individual data points overlaid.
